Fine-tune of the MP-SENet authors' DNS checkpoint (yxlu-0102/MP-SENet best_ckpt/g_best_dns, MIT) on the course train set. Against mpsenet_remix50: start weights (and the source's axis order they need), lr 1e-4 instead of 5e-4, 40 epochs at most. Data settings are the same (remix 0.5). The discriminator starts from random weights (none is published).

One change against mpsenet_remix50: half of the remixed items take their noise from ESC-50 folds 1-4 (1,600 clips that are not course data) instead of another train pair. So 50 % of the items are as recorded, 25 % course speech + course noise, 25 % course speech + ESC-50 noise. From scratch, no pretrained weights. Fold 5 is the newnoise evaluation split and is not in the pool. | stopped by hand after epoch 103 (user decision): validation and newnoise PESQ had been flat for 15 epochs while train PESQ kept rising

One change against mpsenet_esc: half of the remixed items take their speech from Zeroth-Korean (OpenSLR 40, CC BY 4.0; 6,096 three-second clips of 105 speakers, the 10 speakers with background noise left out) instead of the course clean file, scaled to that file's level. So 50 % of the items are as recorded, 25 % course speech remixed, 25 % Zeroth speech remixed; the noise of a remixed item is course or ESC-50 (folds 1-4) half and half as before. From scratch, no pretrained weights. | stopped by hand after epoch 39 (user decision; the user stopped it at 38, one more epoch ran by mistake while closing the run)

Stage 5, experiment 1. One data change against mpsenet_pretrained_dns (fine-tune of the MP-SENet DNS public weights): remixed items (50 % of all) get an SNR from [-10, 15] dB instead of [-5, 20]. Harness changes that do not alter training: the start weights are scored as epoch 0, best.pt / early stopping go by the mean of newnoise and hard:newlow PESQ instead of validation, and a weight average (decay 0.999) is saved next to every epoch.

Stage 5, experiment 2. One data change against mpsenet_pretrained_dns (fine-tune of the MP-SENet DNS public weights): half of the remixed items take their noise from ESC-50 folds 1-4 (so 50 % as recorded, 25 % course noise remixed, 25 % ESC-50 noise), SNR range unchanged at [-5, 20] dB. Fold 5 (newnoise and hard:newlow) is not in the pool, but it is the same 50 classes, so the selection score favours this run. Harness changes as in experiment 1: epoch 0 score of the start weights, selection by newnoise + hard:newlow, weight average 0.999.
